Manage revenue growth with Confido
Confido matches remittances, categorizes every deduction, flags invalid claims, and files disputes automatically so your team recovers revenue without the manual chase.

Food brands face high deduction volume and each retailer and distributor has their own remittance format and compliance requirements. Confido ingests data directly from each source, auto-categorizes every deduction type, flags invalid claims in real time, and files disputes automatically so your team recovers revenue without the manual chase.

Health and wellness brands face high deduction volume, with each vendor using different remittance formats and requirements. Confido ingests data directly from every source, classifies each deduction automatically, flags invalid claims in real time, and submits disputes on your behalf so revenue doesn't slip through the cracks.

Built by experienced CPG operators, Confido replaces manual workflows, siloed planning processes, and fragmented data across systems with a single intelligent platform for finance, accounting, sales, and operations teams.

CPG is a multi-trillion-dollar industry, but the path from factory to store shelf is still powered by spreadsheets, emailed PDFs, and disconnected legacy systems. Every day, brands lose time and money reconciling data, resolving retailer disputes, planning inventory, and coordinating across finance, sales, operations, and supply chain.
